notes: I found the real rule behind the "missing `|`": when a string contains a tab and starts with `t` or a space, the box drops the first character before applying the +8 shift. This explains all of E5 (including `ttab\there` and ` tab\there`) and stays consistent with every E4 tab case (`foo\tbar`, `ab\tcd`, etc. don't start with `t`/space, so no drop).
